relationships.subject: GSK'872
relationships.evidence_quote: Administration of GSK'872 (RIPK3 inhibitor) inhibited TLR4/MyD88 pathway, reduced microglial M1 polarization, promoted microglial M2 polarization and alleviated CCI-induced hyperalgesia.

relationships.subject: TLR4/MyD88 pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: TNF-α/Z-VAD co-induction triggered M1 polarization through TLR4/MyD88 pathway

relationships.subject: GSK'872
relationships.evidence_quote: This suggesting that GSK’872 significantly inhibited RIPK3-mediated necroptosis in the spinal cord of neuropathic pain mice.

key_findings: In CCI mice, RIPK3 inhibitor GSK'872 reduced TLR4/MyD88 expression and M1 markers, raised M2 markers, and relieved hyperalgesia.
In BV-2 microglia, TNF-a/Z-VAD necroptosis induced M1 polarization via TLR4/MyD88.
